refinement_plan_1.analysis: High-priority feedback focuses on CQ coverage for organizations and items, and adding constraints for mandatory elements. CQ5, CQ8, CQ10, and CQ13 are only partially covered. There are also suggestions to use restrictions (cardinality, allValuesFrom/someValuesFrom), GCAs, and equivalence axioms for richer definitions. Documentation enrichment is a lower priority.
